## Direction text (frozen)

The Jiuzhou packaging direction is the **paired** composition of
two concepts:

- **东方秩序** (Eastern order) — calm, asymmetric balance, structured spatial composition, disciplined hierarchy.
- **生物光泽** (biological luster) — organic rhythm, lustrous material, peacock-feather-derived visual language.

The two are intentionally paired. Pure 东方秩序 without 生物光泽
yields a clinical / sterile aesthetic. Pure 生物光泽 without
东方秩序 yields the forbidden "夜店式虹彩" (club iridescence).

## Reading order for the evaluator

1. Composition first (东方秩序): hierarchy, asymmetry, framing.
2. Material second (生物光泽): substrate, luster, micro-rhythm.
3. Motif last: the 5 abstract components; never literal peacock.

## Forbidden end states (re-asserted)

- 大面积浓紫 (large-area saturated purple)
- 大面积写实羽毛 (large-area realistic feather)
- 夜店式虹彩 (club / disco iridescence)

If any of the three is detected, the visual-direction axis is 0
(evaluation; not production rule).
